purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of USGS 3DEP newer seamless 1-meter S1M bare-earth terrain elevation for bounded flood and exposure modelling validation.

entries.name: USGS 3DEP Seamless 1-Meter (S1M) Bare-Earth Digital Elevation Models
entries.provider: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) 3D Elevation Program / The National Map
entries.spatial_scope: United States and territories, with progressively expanding S1M source coverage; not a claim of complete U.S. 1-meter coverage.
entries.temporal_scope: S1M production began in mid-2025; 10 km S1M tiles are added as they become available. Underlying lidar survey years and updates vary by source work unit.
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Seamless 1-meter bare-earth DEM cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs in 10 km by 10 km tiles; source-quality/vertical datum, horizontal CRS and project survey dates must be read per tile.
entries.note: USGS reports 3DEP products free of charge without use restrictions and public domain, but admission and exact source/asset rights remain separately reviewed. The S1M programme is new, 1-meter and 10 km tiled: do not conflate with legacy project-seamless 1-meter DEM, 1/3 arc-second nationwide DEM, source-resolution OPR DEM, digital surface models or LAZ point clouds. Bare-earth heights are terrain, not roofs or true building finished-floor heights. Preserve tile ID, horizontal/vertical CRS and epoch, lidar acquisition/vintage, interpolation, uncertainty, no-data, tile edges, source lineage and relation to USACE NSI or FEMA building coordinates before any model calculation.
